query: What do Samsung Galaxy S8 buyers report about SIM activation, unlocking, and compatibility with their carrier?
search_text: What do buyers report about SIM activation, unlocking, and compatibility with their carrier?

rows.text: It's not an unlocked phone. Carrier locked, said it was an unlocked phone but its not
Reported Lost or stolen. It worked outside of America but when I tried to use it in America I found out it was blacklisted (reported lost or stolen), and AT&T or T-Mobile was unable to activate it.

I bought this phone for my wife as an unlocked .... I bought this phone for my wife as an unlocked phone to work on all carriers. Phone came in with a T-Mobile SIM in the box. When powered up has a T-Mobile logo. Took it to local dealer to get SIM for it and it would not work, because it was only set up for T-Mobile, and was not unlocked. Now it is too late to return the phone.

Fraudulent description, locked to a totally different provider.. The Galaxy S8 is a great phone, if it would work on your provider's network. I'm currently using another Galaxy S8 which I have bought from another vendor and it works perfectly. So I wanted to buy this one as a gift for my wife on our anniversary since it says on the description that it's unlocked. Unfortunately it did NOT work on my carrier (Metro) while on description it says that it's compatible with it. Metro representative advised us to check with Samsung's website itself and we were shocked to find out that this product was Locked to AT&T, that misleading description ruined our anniversary. So I had to return it.

False advertisement. The sellers of this device advertise is as CMDA unlocked which isn't the case... I got a T Mobile phone, which runs off the same CMDA network my carrier uses, yet it will not connect to the network. I've also contacted the seller concerning this matter and have heard NOTHING back from them... Don't waste your time or money if you're looking to buy a phone that is actually unlocked.

Nice phone, please educate yourself before reviewing. As you can see in the pictures the condition is excellent and I got what they promised (an international phone that activated OK with AT&T) For all those haters that just like to put bad stuff without being informed International phones will show sometimes the logo, boot image, sound etc of the last sim card that was previously used in the phone Once you put your sim card it configures the phone and changes all so you get your carrier packages of apps etc... Mine went from t-mobile to AT&T with no issues Last note : the You at the end of the model means unlocked! (See pictures attached) About the seller not replying... I had that impression too but stupid Amazon app won't tell me when the seller has replied my requests I checked my email linked to my amazon account and he did reply the very next day.

5. Continued to run updates until phone reached Android "Oreo" OS version. Verizon logo was now constant on boot-up and restarts. 6. Contacted my nearest "BEMobile" Verizon store, asked if they had any SIM cards for Samsung Galaxy S8 (My phone didn't come with any) They did, I stopped in. 7. AGAIN, Verizon store rep(s) had a hard time using their normal method for phone activation. (They also were able to confirm the phone had Mismatched (2) model numbers) My rep stuck with it. 8. Rep called in to Verizon Customer Service/Customer account/device activation line (In store) and was successfully able to activate the phone and make a test call with a new SIM card that had been tested with another phone and confirmed working. Calls to the store and home were successful. I very much understand the frustration of all these other users with this issue.

Buyers Beware! This phone WILL NOT work with Straight Talk (BYOP) Sim Kit. I doubled check with 2 different Straight Talk customer service rep's and they ran the IMEI# - this phone is 100% INCOMPATIBLE with Straight Talk BYOP (bring your own phone) Sim Kit. Buyers beware! Have your service provider run the IMEI# before you purchase! According to Straight Talk: Factory unlocked GSM phones will work with AT&T or T-Mobile BYOP Sim Kit Not sure why this one doesn't...
Not compatible with Sprint. Had to return.. Phone looks awesome but was not compatible with Sprint carrier.

A bad experience, ( Not the Phone itself). I returned it to the seller as there were too many issues with the phone. (It kept telling me to activate it through Spectrum) when they were not my selected carrier.
Not compatible with Verizon Wireless. Phone was exactly what I wanted but not totally unlocked. Unfortunately, it was not compatible with Verizon Wireless. Seller was prompt with refund.

Beware of the limitations.. If you plan to activate the phone with US carriers you will not get 4G data service. You will get HSPA which is a little slower and good enough for most people. Everything else will work. For example if the phone's IMEI number is not in AT&T's database , then LTE will not be supported. AT&T does not provide a solution such as adding the phone's IMEI into their database when you contact them. This is how they and others discourage people buying phones from others. The sellers won't tell you this. AT&T and Verizon will not tell you this. Your congressman will not do anything about it. Oh well there are other things more important in life.

SIM from Free Mobile not working. Product unable to accept SIM from French carrier Free Mobile. I called Free support and Samsung support. I went also to a Cell Phone Repair specialist before. After a few days, I decided to return the product and am waiting for mu refound.
No SIM card as advertised. Just opened the box and there is no pre-installed SIM card as advertised. I’m pretty leary about this working on Verizon prepaid now as well since reading the reviews
Buyer beware... you lose certain options when it doesn't have a carrier... Wi-Fi calling is one if them

Useless w/o sim card eject device, said it was compatable with Verizon, IT IS NOT!!!. Buying this has been an absolute nightmare. It was delivered to the wrong place, by some miracle it got in my possession only to find it's useless since1) it doesn't come with the sim card eject so I couldn't open it and 2) this was listed as being compatible with Verizon. The Verizon SIM card is bigger than the slot. Awful experience all around

Phone required network unlock code. BEWARE: I bought this phone and it asked me for network unlock code. This was unexpected as the seller advertised it a unlocked phone. I reached out to seller but instead of helping us out objectively the seller seemed it fit to brag about never having such errors in thousands of phones they sold so far.my follow ups did not get any attention. I ended up paying $40 to unlock the phone from my pocket. Ensure you factor in such a scenario when you buy. I bought this phone for a network in India and it kept asking me feel r network unlock code

This is a new phone and Verizon ready. Found this through Amazon, selling on behalf of Cellular Professor. It was listed as new and unlocked for Verizon. The price was right so I bought it. I read the reviews, some saying the phone is refurbished and not compatible with Verizon. I also noticed that those reviews were for other sellers which is misleading. I emailed Cellular Professor (which was quick to respond) and they assured me that it is a new phone and Verizon ready. I received the new phone in the black Samsung box w/Verizon SIM. Nice phone and I am very pleased.

phone works great-very easy to switch/activate on my sprint account. phone works great-very easy to switch/activate on my sprint account. gave only 4 stars because the charger that it came with doesn't fit, even after i bought the mini adapter it still doesn't, so i use my old charger from galaxy 6 with adapter. also, i had to youtube how and where to insert the sim card-no biggie though, just be aware.

Not Verizon compatible. I ordered this phone last week on Amazon from US Wireless and it arrived on time. This phone was listed as a Verizon phone, when taken in to activate phone was not Verizon compatible, returning it now.
